legacy_observations: The selected legacy PE tube is 57 mm tall although that height is reported for the outer aluminum shield only.
The ring bore exceeds the PE outside diameter by 5 mm, so the ring cannot bear directly on the tube annulus.
The legacy shield bottom is 6.4 mm above the platform, without a supporting part.
Films are centered on nominal mating planes, causing half-gauge intersections into the ring, tube and aperture.

The legacy coating contains collapsed bevel triangles and the copper disk has inconsistent face winding. Wrapped foil has one coincident four-face seam edge after vertex welding. These failures are retained in the legacy snapshot.

selected_geometry_hypothesis.foil_scope: Retain 12 micrometre nominal foil gauge and 3 mm lap. A separately recorded 0.1 micrometre seam guard prevents coincident four-face mesh edges. It is not physical adhesive thickness, flexure or contact qualification.
selected_geometry_hypothesis.lower_membrane: The central lower face rests on the PE annulus at 51 mm. Outside the Mylar-covered support it drapes downward to the adhesive on the ring underside. The ring is carried through membrane tension, not an invisible rigid support.
selected_geometry_hypothesis.upper_membrane: A flat sheet bonded to the ring upper face, with its real thickness above the adhesive.
selected_geometry_hypothesis.rationale: A nested ring and lower membrane spanning the 2.5 mm radial gap are a plausible reconstruction of SI Figure 1 b3/b4. The selected height preserves a nominal gap above the emitter and below the aperture without changing published ring or shield dimensions. The photograph does not prove this attachment or equilibrium shape.

adhesive_candidate.source_conflict: The US product page lists 0.089 mm alongside 2.283 mil, whereas the revision-specific PDF gives 0.058 mm / 2.3 mil. This candidate uses the PDF value explicitly.
limits: Manufacturer values are typical, not acceptance specifications.
